Other instruments are decoupled or measure independent physical processes; all four instruments genuinely show white noise around slowly drifting or stepped means.

All four instruments are measuring white noise around stable means; today's resonator_obs cluster (3.95–3.97) is a random fluctuation and does not indicate continued drift. The day-18 discontinuity was a transient glitch or data labeling artifact. Cross-instrument correlations at non-zero lags are false positives from multiple hypothesis testing.

A reference check or scale-factor adjustment was silently applied or drifted after day 10, decoupling all instruments and introducing false time-lag structure.
